name: Kokoro - Kodoku no Teigi
original_name: こころ 孤独の定義
source:
Hirose Takamasa goes through many things, including the loss of his parents and serious injuries.
Since then, he has been living in great loneliness.
Then one day he meets two girls.

It is based on the novel "Kokoro" by Soseki Natsume.
